title: Your Angel Proposal
subtitle: An AI-savvy content producer to turn your podcasts into a steady stream of media.

heard.title: Growing, and stretched on media
heard.body: Your business is growing, and you can't produce the volume of media you need to bring in more inbound attention.

heard.title: Two lanes of media
heard.body: Client media, repurposing client interviews into clips, and your own: a daily audio podcast and a video podcast.

heard.title: Months of untapped content
heard.body: Your YouTube, audio episodes and monthly newsletter hold months of content ready to turn into shorts and clips.

heard.title: A creative collaborator
heard.body: Someone already skilled in Descript and AI tools, who brings their own ideas rather than waiting for exact instructions.

steps.title: Edit podcasts
steps.desc: Run the editing plan for your podcasts in Descript.

steps.title: Clip & repurpose
steps.desc: Turn episodes into clips with Descript, Opus Clip and AI tools.

steps.title: Optimise per platform
steps.desc: Format for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads and Shorts.

steps.title: Client media
steps.desc: Help repurpose client interviews into clips.

steps.title: Organise files
steps.desc: Keep files, workflows and naming tidy.

steps.title: Pitch ideas
steps.desc: Suggest new ways to repurpose your content library.

cards.title: 20 hrs / week
cards.desc: Part-time to start, growing into a media team as revenue grows.

cards.title: Reports to you
cards.desc: You set the strategy; they bring creative ideas and execute.

cards.title: AI-savvy creative
cards.desc: 3+ years' experience, skilled in Descript, Opus Clip and AI tools.

packages.label: TWO WAYS TO WORK WITH US
packages.title: Choose the support level that fits you
left_items: Candidate profiles with portfolios, work history and an intro video
Payroll, incentives and health vouchers handled for your Angel
A Project Manager checking in with you monthly
Your Freedom Plan blueprint, with suggested KPIs
You manage your Angel's performance day to day
Free replacement within the first 30 days, and a fee after
packages.right_title: Angel Managed: we support you both
right_items: A Client and Angel Experience team supporting you both
Retraining and performance support for your Angel
Free replacements, whenever you need them
packages.note: Start with either, and switch as your media team grows.

pricing.col1_desc: The standard $800, with your 10% returning-client discount. Est. total $1,760–$2,020/mo at 20 hrs/week.
pricing.col2_desc: Adds your Client and Angel Experience team and free replacements. Est. total $2,040–$2,300/mo at 20 hrs/week.
pricing.col3_desc: Set by each candidate and shown on their profile. We take no cut of it.
pricing.begin_text: a $500 USD refundable Freedom Plan deposit — explained on the next page
pricing.footnote: All figures in USD, excl. tax. Totals are the agency fee plus your Angel's pay at 20 hrs/week, so they move with the rate you choose.

freedom.term_bullet: 3-month minimum, then 30 days' notice to cancel
freedom.choose_bullet: You choose from 3–4 profiles with portfolios, with an optional creativity test first
